Figure 1 presents two distinct line graphs, labeled A and B, both plotting data against time. Graph A illustrates the trend of average leghorn egg production (in dozens) over years, while Graph B shows the structural effect on egg production (as a percentage) over the same period. Both graphs share the same horizontal axis, labeled “Години” (Years), which spans from 2008 to 2021. The vertical axis in Graph A is labeled “Средни изходи (десети)” (Average output (dozens)), with values ranging from 20 to 280. The vertical axis in Graph B is labeled “Структурен ефект върху средни изходи (%)” (Structural effect on average output (%)), with values ranging from 0.0 to 2.0. Both axes use linear scales with uniform numerical labels.

Graph A displays a single red line with circular markers. The line begins at a value of 280 in 2008, decreases to 260 in 2010, rises to 270 in 2012, then declines steadily to 20 in 2021. The line exhibits a downward trend from 2012 to 2021, with no visible local maxima or minima other than the initial and final points.

Graph B also displays a single red line with circular markers. The line begins at a value of 1.5% in 2008, decreases to 0.0% in 2012, then increases steadily to 2.0% in 2021. The line exhibits a downward trend from 2008 to 2012, followed by an upward trend from 2012 to 2021.
